amendments.normalized_body: Fix compilation errors: three functions (density_repro_factor, tan_repro_factor, no2_repro_factor) are defined twice in crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs with divergent implementations (lines ~1449-1487 vs ~1503-1541). Additionally, snapshot.rs:338 calls dominant_repro_suppression() which does not exist anywhere in the codebase. The code cannot compile at all. Remove the duplicate definitions (keeping whichever version is intended) and either implement dominant_repro_suppression or remove the repro_dominant_suppression field from TankSnapshot.

Fix the test_denitrification_reduces_nitrate_accumulation integration test (crates/tank_core/tests/denitrification.rs). The active_denitrification case uses SubstrateKind::ActivePlanted with nutrient_store_mg_n_total=50.0 while the control uses InertSand with nutrient_store_mg_n_total=0.0. This 50mg N reservoir leaks into the water column and overwhelms denitrification, causing with_denit to finish with HIGHER NO3 (24.89 mg/L) than without_denit (19.00 mg/L). Either equalize the nutrient stores between cases or remove the store from the active case so the only controlled variable is suboxic zone geometry and denitrifier activity.

Apply the same division-by-zero guard to ca_min_mg_per_l and mg_min_mg_per_l that was applied to gh_min_d. In update_molt_stress (shrimp.rs:459,464), ca_stress and mg_stress divide by params.ca_min_mg_per_l and params.mg_min_mg_per_l respectively without a .max(0.01) guard. Similarly, molt_mineral_modifier (shrimp.rs:1559-1560) divides by ca_min_mg_per_l and mg_min_mg_per_l without guards. If a user sets these parameters to zero (as the test_zero_gh_min_parameter_uses_defensive_guard test exercises for gh_min_d), NaN/Inf propagates through stress and molt calculations.

Remove or use EventCause::HighDensity (crates/tank_core/src/types/events.rs:49). The variant was added in this changeset but is never emitted by any code path — no call site references EventCause::HighDensity.

Build is currently broken. `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:1454`, `:1473`, and `:1485` add second definitions of `density_repro_factor`, `tan_repro_factor`, and `no2_repro_factor`, which already exist at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:1508`, `:1526`, and `:1537`. `crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs:7` also imports `dominant_repro_suppression` while `crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs:375` redefines it locally. `cargo test -p tank_core snapshot` fails with E0428/E0255, so this patch does not compile.

The new snapshot-side `dominant_repro_suppression` implementation in `crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs:375` does not match the real reproduction model. It omits the molt-stress factor used by `update_reproductive_readiness` at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:679`, folds TAN and nitrite into a generic `chemistry` bucket instead of the separate `tan`/`nitrite` diagnostics in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:1572` and `:1574`, and uses different suppression curves/floors than the shared helper starting at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:1548`. Even after the compile error is fixed, `repro_dominant_suppression` can disagree with the actual readiness calculation and mislead debugging.
